description: Mass ratio look-elsewhere effect — corrected significance

alpha.honest_assessment: α formula was found by searching Fibonacci combinations, then validated for perturbation stability. The look-elsewhere correction must be applied. Additional validation: the SAME Fibonacci indices appear in other predictions (Feigenbaum, Koide, gauge groups), which constrains the effective trial count.

koide.note: F₃/F₄ = 2/3 is the simplest ratio; no search needed

weinberg.note: Small search space, but 4.4σ from PDG at M_Z

falsification.hypothesis: 5.7 ppm α match is significant after look-elsewhere
falsification.assessment: Search space: 35434 formulas. Corrected p (Šidák): 0.2553. FALSIFIED: look-elsewhere destroys significance. NOTE: This is a conservative estimate. Cross-prediction constraints (same F indices in Feigenbaum, Koide, gauge groups) may reduce the effective trial count, but quantifying this requires a joint analysis (see exp_10).
